feeds.title: BEST BEFORE END DATE
feeds.description: Best Before End Date is a personal blog run by Sharon who is 59 years old and is embracing her midlife. She also talks about talking her views and experiences on midlife. In her travel blog, she talks about her holidays, cottage stays, and many other adventures she experiences in her life.

feeds.title: My Itchy Travel Feet
feeds.description: My Itchy Travel Feet is a travel blog manged by DONNA L. HULL who is the founder and editor of the website. My Itchy Travel Feet articles inspire boomers to get up off the couch and go. They help baby boomers explore the world one adventure at a time.

feeds.title: My Senior Gap Year Blog
feeds.description: My Senior Gap Year Blog covers the story of Chris Herrmann, who at the tail end of his life embarks on an amazing travel journey. He travels for straight twelve months, backpacking across several parts of the world. He feels that it's never too late to start your journey. In his blog, you will read about his travel and adventures across the world.

feeds.title: One Road at a Time
feeds.description: We are Patti and Abi. After retiring early to live a simpler life, travel the world, and hopefully, inspire others to redefine retirement. We've been traveling through life together for 40+ years, embracing each new chapter and each new adventure with open minds. Our travels have taken us to four continents and to 19 countries. In their blog, they give travel tips for different countries and information about different locations.

feeds.title: Lori Loves Adventure
feeds.description: Lori Loves Adventure is a midlife travel blog for women to discover a blissful life through travel. The blog covers several Travel destinations and travel stories for explorers. They have a complete travel guide to solve all your travel-related queries.

feeds.title: Your Time to Fly Blog
feeds.description: Your Time to Fly is a midlife-travel blog website, especially for women in their 40s and 50s who are looking to enjoy the later part of their life. They love to travel with their friends, partners, or even on their own. Their blog gives you updates and information about their travel and trips. The blog also features information on Cozy Romantic, Most Romantic Resorts, Getaways in New England for Couples and more.

feeds.title: 50 Shades of Age » Travel
feeds.description: 50 Shades of Age is a personal blog managed by a woman who is 60-something years old as she mentions on her site. She loves blogging, shopping, cappuccino sipping, book clubbing, healthy eating, yoga-loving, world traveler. In her travel blog, she has more than 450 articles that will help you get better at traveling and solve all your travel-related problems.

feeds.title: To Travel Too Blog
feeds.description: Baby Boomers is a travel blog for aspiring travelers. Here they share our Baby Boomer travel experiences, thoughts, aspirations, and intentions as we travel. Jane and Duncan in their travel blog, talk about Global travel guides, hotel reviews, travel tips and tricks, transport, tours, and more.

feeds.title: The Backpacking Housewife
feeds.description: If you've always wanted to prioritise travel later in life then why wait until it's too late. If not now, when?

feeds.title: Midlifechic » Travel
feeds.description: Midlife Chic is a UK blog for women over 40 who are getting their groove back. Written by the former editor of Selfridges magazine, it focuses on classic chic featuring high street fashion and beauty. It is a forum for midlife women to discuss the issues that they face as they enter into the second half of their life.

feeds.title: Jane's Midlife Journey
feeds.description: Travel Guides Top 10 Things to do 101 Things to do in Bournemouth 101 Things to do in Bournemouth with Babies & Toddlers About Me Hi, I'm Jane. 7 years ago I stopped work so I could travel more. I spend my winters on my adventures around the world. So far, I have notched up…

feeds.title: My Senior Gap Year
feeds.description: Its never too late. Join me on My Senior Gap Year.

feeds.title: Midlife Travel Bug
feeds.description: Midlife Travel Bug is a Canadian empty‑nester couple's blog sharing offbeat, budget‑savvy travel adventures and destination guides—from Puglia to Portugal—with practical tips, video vlogs, and mid‑life wanderlust inspiration.

feeds.title: Midlife Butterfly Blog
feeds.description: A space for midlife women ready to rewrite the rules. Through stories of mindset shifts, transformative travel, and meaningful connection, this blog inspires you to embrace change, rediscover your purpose, and create the life you truly want—on your own terms.

feeds.title: Midlife Musings » Travel
feeds.description: Midlife Musings is a midlife personal travel blog by Debbie, offering reflective and immersive stories from global destinations

feeds.title: Deb's World
feeds.description: A blog about midlife, travel, adventure - and all things in between. Follow to keep up with Deb's World. It is full of stories, travels, adventures, photos and love.

feeds.title: Journey Woman
feeds.description: Journey Woman is the world's original solo travel publication for women, founded by the late Evelyn Hannon in 1994. In addition to publishing award-winning travel editorials with their contributing writers, they create a safe, inviting place where women can research, learn, and find inspiration to live the life of their dreams, with travel as a shared passion. Wade through their blog and learn more about travel tips, destinations, deals, offers, resources, books, stories, articles, events, webinars, and more.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Girl's Midlife Diary
feeds.description: Yorkshire Girl's Midlife Diary follows Joanne, a midlife mum navigating everyday adventures, personal reflections, travel escapades, and the ups and downs of life in her mid‑40s.

feeds.title: Midlife Wanders
feeds.description: We're midlife slowmads wandering the world.

feeds.title: Crunchy Tales » Travel
feeds.description: Discover travel tips and inspiring destinations tailored for midlife women. From solo adventures to group retreats, explore how to make every journey great

feeds.title: Silver Magazine » Travel
feeds.description: Silver is a magazine at the beating heart of the 50 generation. We, the Boomers and Generation X-ers, the moon landers, the ravers and acid takers, the punks and hippies, the intrepid travelers, the foodies, fashionistas, freelancers and fanatics.

feeds.title: Midlife Sentence » Travel
feeds.description: Midlife Sentence is a personal website handled by a 40-year-old woman who is a freelance consultant and likes to share stories about herself and her family. On her travel blog, she reviews destinations and shares experiences of her family's travel. She gives a unique review of destinations she has visited and follows up with amazing stories.

feeds.title: Adventures in Wonderland
feeds.description: Alison Armstrong and Don Read are in their 70s running a travel website. Both of them love to travel and so decided to star a travel blog named Adventures in Wonderland. In this blog, they talk in detailed about their travel journey and the adventures they witnessed.

feeds.title: Midlife Creative
feeds.description: Midlife Creative is a family travel blog website that features all the travel experiences of Anna Haugen and her family. Anna loves spending her time cooking, playing piano, and exploring nature. In her travel blog, she tells stories about her family's vacations and outings across several places.

feeds.title: Nomadic MidLife Blog
feeds.description: Nomadic MidLife is a travel blog run by the Chids. They took an early retirement to start an epic journey, a long road trip down the Pan-American Highway to avoid a midlife crisis. Their blog is updated frequently with stories from their epic road trip down the Pan-American Highway.

feeds.title: Booming On Travels
feeds.description: Booming On Travels is a travel blog website celebrating the good life and discovering the best of Canberra & the world. The blog is run by Christine who is a writer, traveler, photographer, baby boomer, foodie, and lover of big dogs and fancy things. In her blog, she shares the stories of her travel, activities, adventures, and more. She also gives out travel tips and tricks to make your journey better.

feeds.title: Blog - Destination Someplace
feeds.description: The Over 50s Independent Travel Blog. Hello and welcome to our internet hideout! We are two travel-obsessed Yorkshire folk who seek new experiences and places, especially along the back roads of Europe. We've been around, by plane, train, and automobile (and even hitch-hiking but that's another story). We share our travel tips on this website to help you do the same!

feeds.title: Midlife And Beyond » Travel
feeds.description: Life, Style and Beauty
